method: Actual PNG inspection after isolated headless Chromium rendering; all network requests blocked. Not inferred from DOM metrics alone.
observations: Shahmukhi letters are joined and legible at desktop and phone widths; headings, body text and navigation do not overlap.

The index presents its incomplete-book scope before the ordered reading links. Technical unit identifiers wrap on a 390-pixel phone, but the linked Punjabi titles remain readable and the document does not overflow.
The introduction construction photo loads with correct aspect ratio; the preface and whole-number exercise-page text remain readable.
The evaluation section keeps Punjabi prose RTL and numerical expressions LTR, including the base/exponent distinction.
The desktop worked table displays the instruction column on the left and math column on the right. Canonical 012b visibly repeats 3^x; the distinct correction link is visible beside it.

At 390 pixels, the table initially shows its instruction column and scroll cue. Actual horizontal scrolling exposes the math column, including 3^x, 3·3·3·3 and 81, without document-level horizontal overflow.

Original source-image links, bilingual explanatory links and separately marked original corrections are readable. Canonical tiny equation JPEGs are not mirrored or silently replaced by comparison redraws.
limitations: Screenshots inspect representative surfaces, not every point on every long page. Automated full-document element bounds, image loading, ID/math and link checks supplement them.
This is browser visual verification, not recorded screen-reader testing or native-language certification.
